चोच चोच, अम्, n. the bark of Cinnamon
Albiflorum or of another kind of cinnamon; bark,
rind in general; skin, hide; the uneatable part of a
fruit; the fruit of the fan-palm; the cocoa-nut; a
banana or plantain.
